newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to probe fax dumping claim by Philips.
newsitem.headline: EU to probe fax dumping claim by Philips.

text.p: The European Commission has launched an investigation into allegations that seven Asian nations are dumping personal fax machines in Europe.

According to the Official Journal available on Tuesday, Dutch electronics giant Philips Electronics NV has complained that imports of personal fax machines from South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia and China are "causing material injury to the community industry".
Personal fax machines are described as weighing less than five kilograms and normally used at home or on a desktop.
The Journal said the Commission would launch the investigation by sending questionnaires to manufacturers, exporters and importers to determine the size of the European market.
